∀ (X Y : Type) [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space Y] (f : X → Y),
  Continuous f → Function.Bijective f → IsClosedMap f ∧ ∃ e, ∀ (x : X), e x = f x

# name: set-compact-to-hausdorff-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Exercises.compact_to_hausdorff
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['Unit', 'Unit', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'id', 'continuous_id', 'Function.bijective_id'], True, 'have key : ∀ (X Y : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace X] [inst2 : TopologicalSpace Y] [inst3 : CompactSpace X] [inst4 : T2Space Y] (f : X → Y) (hf : Continuous f) (hb : Function.Bijective f), IsClosedMap f ∧ ∃ e : X ≃ₜ Y, ∀ x, e x = f x := by\n  intro X Y inst1 inst2 inst3 inst4 f hf hb\n  exact (⟨hf.isClosedMap, ⟨hf.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := Equiv.ofBijective f hb), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩)\nexact @key (Unit) (Unit) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (id) (continuous_id) (Function.bijective_id)'),
    (['Fin 3', 'Fin 3', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', '![1, 2, 0]', 'continuous_of_discreteTopology', '(by decide)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (X Y : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace X] [inst2 : TopologicalSpace Y] [inst3 : CompactSpace X] [inst4 : T2Space Y] (f : X → Y) (hf : Continuous f) (hb : Function.Bijective f), IsClosedMap f ∧ ∃ e : X ≃ₜ Y, ∀ x, e x = f x := by\n  intro X Y inst1 inst2 inst3 inst4 f hf hb\n  exact (⟨hf.isClosedMap, ⟨hf.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := Equiv.ofBijective f hb), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩)\nexact @key (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (![1, 2, 0]) (continuous_of_discreteTopology) ((by decide))'),
    (['Bool', 'Bool', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'inferInstance', 'not', 'continuous_of_discreteTopology', '(by decide)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (X Y : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace X] [inst2 : TopologicalSpace Y] [inst3 : CompactSpace X] [inst4 : T2Space Y] (f : X → Y) (hf : Continuous f) (hb : Function.Bijective f), IsClosedMap f ∧ ∃ e : X ≃ₜ Y, ∀ x, e x = f x := by\n  intro X Y inst1 inst2 inst3 inst4 f hf hb\n  exact (⟨hf.isClosedMap, ⟨hf.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := Equiv.ofBijective f hb), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩)\nexact @key (Bool) (Bool) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (inferInstance) (not) (continuous_of_discreteTopology) ((by decide))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]

goal.text: IsClosedMap f ∧ ∃ e, ∀ (x : X), e x = f x
